decisions.reason: Confirmed a non-load-bearing misattribution: the published Fourier theorem states basis, Parseval and coefficient isometry, not Hodge decomposition. The local coefficient formula already proves u=Pu+grad f, with the H^(s+1) estimate w_k^2/(4pi^2|k|^2)<=1+1/(4pi^2) for k!=0. Replaced only the attribution by an explicit reference to this local derivation; all spaces, operators and claims are preserved.

F1 incorrectly counted one complex coordinate per frequency. Each coefficient lies in C^3, so the ambient block is C^(3M_K)=R^(6M_K). Corrected both dimensions. The actual nested extraction in proof 1.1 already processes six real coordinates, F2 controls those coordinates by the scalar mean-value theorem, and the finite-block/tail argument proves simultaneous convergence in every Sobolev order. This is a nonfatal fact-restatement typo; Statement and extraction are unchanged.

Confirmed an indexing defect in the derivative clause and induction, not a failure of the all-order smoothness argument: the old j-1 differentiation rule did not define Phi_0. Defined Phi_0=u and displayed the exact binomial Leibniz formula for Phi_r when r>=1, retaining every mixed derivative including r=0. The base now covers j=0 and j=1 explicitly; bounded bilinear transport and bounded linear multipliers yield C^r G from C^r u and hence C^(r+1) u, with evaluation identifying continuous mixed derivatives and one-sided endpoints.

Confirmed a nonfatal domain-notation omission: the theorem hypotheses already quantify only over smooth divergence-free data, but the final bare norm-ball notation fails to restate that universe. A literal full-H^s-ball reading would not define a smooth solenoidal solution map, since its t=0 trace must satisfy both conditions. Made D_(s,B) exactly the class already required by the hypotheses and contract; the core energy/Gronwall/interpolation proof and its claims are unchanged. Also chose the explicitly uniform upper bound exp(6W_(s-1)BT/s)(4B)^((s-1)/s), removing pair dependence from the displayed proof constant.

The opening scope account omitted AC_omega although both cited theorems require it. Added the exact countable-choice assumption and dependency. Independently confirmed the digest pressure issue: existence/uniqueness do not state pressure reconstruction, while lem-periodic-pressure-reconstruction states the smooth mean-zero scalar pressure, correct primitive-equation sign and uniqueness; added that supplier and its claims 1-3. Made the smooth divergence-free bounded-data domain and input L2 topology explicit. Read the CMI announcement and preserved its dated announcement/evaluation qualification without inferring a periodic global theorem.

consumer_reviews.snippet: 1.2 **Bounded multiplier and smoothness.** Since $|k_ik_j|/|k|_2^2\le1$ for $k\ne0$, the pressure coefficient map satisfies $\|p\|_{H^r}\le\sum_{i,j}\|u_iu_j\|_{H^r}$ by the triangle inequality, for every real $r$. The hypotheses of the smoothness bootstrap [[lem-cm-strong-solution-smoothness-bootstrap]] hold for $u$, so all its time derivatives are continuous into every $H^r$. Applying [F4] at arbitrarily high orders proves joint spatial and time smoothness and identifies the coefficients of all derivatives. Finally $\widehat p(0)=0$ gives the zero mean.
